description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Create New Organization.

Request body guide
Field Description
externalId Use externalId to add the external id of the organization.
properties Use properties to add all the custom fields.
contacts Use contacts to link contacts to an organization. Only accepts emails. Link existing contacts. Otherwise creates a contact with the given email and link it.
owners User owners to add organization owners. Accepts object array with user id and the owner type.
links Use links to link custom objects with organizations.
Account Linking

Cannot link accounts to an organization when creating an organization. There is a separate API (Change Parent Entity) in the Account section to assign accounts to an organization.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Example:

  • With external id: /organizations/extid-id
  • With internal id: /organizations/srcid-id

Field Description
externalId Use externalId to add external id of the contact
email Use email to add email id of the contact

organizationIds Use organizationIds to link contacts to an organization. Accepts Velaris internal Id. User either organizationIds or organizationExternalIds Example: [1, 2]
organizationExternalIds Use organizationExternalIds to link contacts to an organization. Accepts external Id of the organization. User either organizationIds or organizationExternalIds Example: ["ajislk-1asdas-1231fg", "tcsd-gogk-asdm"]
accountIds Use accountIds to link contacts to an acount. Accepts Velaris internal Id. User either accountIds or accountExternalIds Example: [1, 2]
accountExternalIds Use accountExternalIds to link contacts to an acount. Accepts external Id of the account. User either accountIds or accountExternalIds Example: ["ajislk-1asdas-1231fg", "tcsd-gogk-asdm"]
links Use links to link custom objects with contacts.

description.content:
The Velaris Public API for the AI Customer Success Platform. Manage organizations, accounts, contacts, opportunities, risks, custom objects, activities, notes, tickets, tasks, users, surveys and more. Base URL https://api.euw1.velaris.io.
